fields.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Jinx''' switches between ''{{cci|Pow-Pow.png|Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow}}'', her minigun, and ''{{cci|Fishbones.png|Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones}}'', her rocket launcher.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Pow-Pow:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a {{tip|stack}} of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
fields.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30/2 to 130/2}}%|Attack Speed per Subsequent Stack|{{ap|30/4 to 130/4}}%|Maximum Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 130}}%}}
fields.description3: {{sbc|Fishbones:}} Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|110% AD}} {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} but loses {{sti|{{as|10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
fields.description4: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
